name: Lycia Therapeutics, Inc.
summary: Lycia Therapeutics, Inc., a biotechnology company, engages in the discovery and development of therapeutics designed to degrade disease-causing extracellular proteins for the treatment of autoimmune, inflammatory, and allergic diseases. The company develops the LYTAC platform, a modular technology designed to create therapeutics that selectively reduce the levels of pathogenic proteins. Its therapeutic candidate LCA-0061 degrades immunoglobulin E (IgE) for the treatment of allergic diseases, including food allergy.
